Attributes.Details: Each point adds one damage to an unarmed or weapon strike before armour and resistance. Weapon damage adds to this base value. Strength does not change melee reach.
Each point adds six maximum health. Every five points add one armour. Armour reduces incoming damage before percentage resistance is applied.
Each point increases attack rate by 2.5 percent of the weapon's base rate. Faster attacks shorten both cast time and cooldown. The final rate is capped.
Every two points add one percentage point of resistance. This combines with Willpower, up to a total of 60 percent resistance.
Each point adds one percentage point of resistance. This combines with half of Intelligence, up to a total of 60 percent resistance.
Each point adds one percent of base movement speed. Ten Speed uses the configured base speed. This affects character movement and path following, but not camera panning.
Charisma currently unlocks eligible skills. It has no direct social or combat effect yet; those systems are still being designed.
Luck currently unlocks eligible skills. It has no direct loot or combat effect yet; those systems are still being designed.
